snippet.title: Night of the Extinct - Official Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
PLAY ON STEAM FOR FREE: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3805410/Night_of_the_Extinct/
The Silvercity Sharks and ArtOfGerald are collaborating to bring you a new horror experience...

Go back in time and see the creatures of yesterday, but you might be doing more than just seeing. These creatures come to life at night, and it's your job to survive your time here.

Playing as a content creator in the 2010's, you take the challenge to stay overnight in the esteemed museum in town, yet things don't go quite as expected.

Stealth around the enemy and move through the labyrinth of halls. Pick up objects to throw and deter the enemy from it's post. Meet new friends and foes throughout your journey.
